default_rule: license metadata unknown does not automatically exclude from research shortlist, but does not grant permissions

axes.download: verify normal original provider access, applicable license OR documented lawful basis, exact file hashes/size and user approval
axes.offline_inference: check exact use restrictions and safety/identity consent
axes.redistribution: separate original and derivative rights; not inferred from individual study
axes.torrent_seed: distribution plus public IP and upload, separate explicit approval
axes.commercial: not intended use; do not apply commercial limitations as automatic rejection for individual noncommercial study

sources.fact: upstream confirms community finetuning under license and license-terms inherited for distribution
publisher lists inherited community license, donor sources and notices
creator publishes model lineage and component file list but license tag unknown
Japanese Copyright Act art30 personal copying / art30-4 limited non-enjoyment purposes; not universal permission
torrent is redistribution and cannot bypass original rights

unverified_facts: specific download authorization for these complete derivatives
licenses accepted by user for parent or gated dependencies
actual source files checked and pinned
